assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE production game sprite atlas PNG, 2048x2048, transparent background. Make sixteen DIFFERENT isometric industrial science fiction buildings for a nostalgic 2011 mobile space empire strategy game. Match old prerendered 3D sprites, gritty realistic metal textures, NOT cartoon, NOT smooth modern low-poly, muted gunmetal, worn silver, small blue indicator lights, occasional orange furnace glow. STRICT atlas layout: exactly four columns and four rows, sixteen equal square cells. Each building completely inside its cell with transparent padding 12% each side, building centered. No cell borders, NO TEXT, no labels, no UI. All buildings use same camera: isometric view from above, front and right side visible, roof visible. Each sits on its own small diamond-shaped steel floor foundation. Same scale and upper-left lighting. Row 1 left to right: (1) METAL MINE smelting furnace, red pipes, chimney steam; (2) CRYSTAL MINE angular extraction machinery with blue crystal vein; (3) GAS EXTRACTOR tall green-lit tanks and pipes; (4) SOLAR POWER STATION two curved blue photovoltaic roof panels. Row 2: (5) METAL STORAGE square warehouse with heavy shutter and orange container; (6) CRYSTAL STORAGE steel vault with cyan glass chambers; (7) GAS STORAGE cluster of three silver cylindrical tanks; (8) ROBOTICS FACTORY steel workshop with two articulated yellow cranes. Row 3: (9) SHIPYARD large open repair dock with small spaceship under construction; (10) RESEARCH LAB circular sci-fi laboratory with blue domed glass roof; (11) RADAR FACILITY single large white dish and control block; (12) FUSION REACTOR thick industrial cooling towers and electric blue core. Row 4: (13) NANITE FACTORY compact advanced robotic fabrication plant, silver towers; (14) ALLIANCE DEPOT armored communications headquarters with antennas; (15) MOON BASE joined low lunar habitat modules; (16) WORMHOLE GENERATOR large upright circular metallic gate, glowing blue center. Keep silhouettes distinctive and readable at 140 pixels. Real transparency, not checkerboard. Buildings fully isolated from one another. This is one sprite atlas, not a finished game screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless-feeling vertical background for a 2011 mobile science fiction empire strategy game's isometric colony map. Portrait 1024x1536. An EMPTY gritty industrial platform on a barren alien planet, isometric camera from above with front/right sides visible. Dark worn blue-grey metal floor tiles, small cables and pipes embedded in ground, wide diamond grid of paving stones, few painted yellow caution lines. Most of central 85 percent of image is clear continuous FLAT buildable floor. Around outer edges only: rocky cliff faces, retaining metal walls, a few tiny dim blue runway lights, rusty outcrops. Bottom edge can show platform's deep vertical cliff. Top edge distant brown alien rocks. Realistic aged prerendered 3D aesthetic from an early smartphone game, restrained texture contrast so foreground building sprites remain readable. Muted gunmetal, charcoal, brown stone, hints of teal reflected light. No buildings, no spaceships, no planets in sky, no people, no text, no UI, no logos. Orthographic/isometric, not cinematic horizon. All image area filled with terrain.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production spacecraft sprite atlas for a faithful early Galaxy Empire mobile-game recreation. The attached SMALL game advertisement is the STYLE AND SHAPE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Study especially its four ship selection thumbnails (Light Fighter, Heavy Fighter, Cruiser, Battleship) and the large foreground angular ship. Match THAT aesthetic: silver-grey and desaturated blue metal, long narrow angular hulls, intricate inset panel lines, stacked mechanical armour, forked prows, bulky machinery behind narrow noses, hard chamfered edges, old pre-rendered 3D space strategy asset art. Blue cyan lights, very restrained bronze accents, no prominent red racing stripes, no rounded toy-like hulls. IMPORTANT: camera view should match the thumbnails, a 3/4 view from ABOVE, showing broad TOP surface and side; ships face to the RIGHT for left-versus-right battle animation. Output a single square transparent PNG sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells, isolated objects, no text, no labels, no UI. All cell padding at least 12%, no parts crossing cell boundaries. Row1 left-to-right: small LIGHT FIGHTER with two slim silver mandibles and tiny blue winglets; HEAVY FIGHTER with triangular mechanical wings and heavier central hull; CRUISER long wedge hull with several small blue engine modules; BATTLESHIP elongated flat heavy segmented silver armoured hull with twin prongs at nose. Row2: DREADNOUGHT darker sleek angular long hull with extensive blue engine array; BOMBER squat split hull covered in missile tubes; DESTROYER the largest silver armoured ship with two huge parallel front weapon barrels, directly inspired by reference foreground ship's structural language; SMALL CARGO SHIP square modular transport. Row3: LARGE CARGO SHIP long freighter with heavy cargo boxes; COLONY SHIP modular cylindrical colony transport and landing modules; RECYCLER industrial salvage vessel with front grapple arms; PROBE compact mechanical drone and blue scanning eye. Row4: SOLAR SATELLITE with four blue rectangular panels; ROCKET LAUNCHER ground weapon on square metal footing; LASER CANNON on metal footing; PLASMA CANNON on metal footing. Consistent top-left lighting. Transparent background, no fake transparency pattern or space backdrop. Match the reference's low-saturation military sci-fi art, high surface detail but clear silhouettes at 100px.
